focus: Built-in parser validation and CSV serialization
repairs: Canonical JSON rejects duplicate hyperedge IDs, invalid hyperedge IDs, invalid vertex identifiers, non-finite weights, and object/non-scalar time metadata.
CSV parsing rejects unterminated quotes, quote characters in unquoted fields, and characters after closing quotes.
Incidence rows require hyperedge_id and vertex_id and reject non-finite weights.
Edge-list rows require exactly two columns.
H2V/V2H/H2H malformed colon syntax is rejected instead of silently ignored.
CSV document output emits CRLF row separators as documented.
